name: qlrisk_initial_margin
title: Initial margin (ISDA SIMM)
description: Initial margin with qlrisk's IM calculator: method 'simm' (ISDA SIMM delta / vega / curvature margin by risk class, MPOR scaling), 'schedule' (BCBS-IOSCO grid by product and maturity, net-to-gross adjusted) or 'var'. One position gives its IM; several give the portfolio IM with netting across positions. Position fields: notional (number, required); product_type (string, required); remaining_maturity (number, required); volatility (number, default 0.0); delta (number, default 1.0); delta_sensitivities (object); vega_sensitivities (object); curvature_sensitivities (object); correlation_within (number, default 0.5); correlation_across (number, default 0.25); margin_period_of_risk (number, default 0.03968253968253968); gross_notional (['number', 'null']); net_to_gross_ratio (number, default 0.4). Example: {"method": "simm", "positions": [{"notional": 10000000, "product_type": "irs", "remaining_maturity": 5, "delta_sensitivities": {"USD-5Y": 4500}}]}.
